name: crew-shots
description: Shooting: one item per shot. The cinematographer makes the start frame (critic + director storyboard gate), the actors perform when the shot is acted, the cinematographer shoots takes, the critic judges every take, the director approves the take.

steps.name: frame
steps.job: Role: cinematographer, making this shot's start frame. Load skill cast-and-sets and the project bible. Inputs: the item's data (the shot) plus <dir>/bible/tokens.md and <dir>/assets.json. BUILD RULE: the base image of every frame is the approved MASTER for this camera (assets.json shot_refs[id][0], or the set canon / family_frames for the camera family), edited with nano-banana-pro/edit; add people and vehicles from their approved masters (shot_refs). Never generate a frame from text alone. Follow the bible Geography and the specs' frame maps. 16:9, 2K, jpeg, under <dir>/plates/<id>/frame/. SELF-GATE (mandatory before recording): run python3 /data/workspaces/<workspace>/.pi/skills/crew/scripts/canon_check.py <frame> <dir>/checklists.json <dir>/plates/<id>/frame/canon_check.json --family <assets.json shot_family_check[id]> --shot <the item data saved as <dir>/plates/<id>/item.json> --ledger <dir>/ledger.jsonl. Fix every NO by another Nano edit of the same frame with the masters as references (max 3 rounds). Fix props by a LOCAL edit or a finish note, never by re-editing the whole frame with another approved frame as image 2 (it copies that frame and loses the shot). Record only a frame that passes; if it cannot pass in 3 rounds, record it with the remaining fails listed. Log spend to <dir>/ledger.jsonl. Record {"files": [chosen frame first], "kind": "image", "canon_check": path, "summary": ...}. Never edit shared project files.

steps.name: frame_revise
steps.job: Role: the same cinematographer as the frame step. Read the frame critic's verdict files (vex.factory.item.get shows the critic step output) and any director answer in the item history. Fix every real defect by Nano edit of your best candidate, WITH the item's refs (canon set + faces) as references; for each defect you reject, give the reason (check direction claims yourself: a vehicle moves where its nose points; reverse cockpit views mirror the sides). Write to <dir>/plates/<id>/frame/. Record {"files": [the chosen frame first], "kind": "image", "fixed": [...], "rejected": [...]}. SELF-GATE (mandatory before recording): run python3 /data/workspaces/<workspace>/.pi/skills/crew/scripts/canon_check.py <frame> <dir>/checklists.json <dir>/plates/<id>/frame/canon_check.json --family <assets.json shot_family_check[id]> --shot <the item data saved as <dir>/plates/<id>/item.json> --ledger <dir>/ledger.jsonl. Fix every NO by another Nano edit of the same frame with the masters as references (max 3 rounds). Fix props by a LOCAL edit or a finish note, never by re-editing the whole frame with another approved frame as image 2 (it copies that frame and loses the shot). Record only a frame that passes; if it cannot pass in 3 rounds, record it with the remaining fails listed.

steps.name: storyboard
steps.question: Director: is this start frame approved for the shot (continue), re-made (redo), or is the shot dropped (close)?

steps.name: perform
steps.job: Role: the actor(s) in this shot. Load and follow skill performance. Inputs: the item's data (the shot from shots.json: id, read, cast, lines, eyelines, duration) plus <dir>/cast/ and <dir>/assets.json. If the shot has no acting, record {"files": [], "skipped": true}. Otherwise make the drivers and re-voiced lines under <dir>/plates/<id>/perform/. Record {"files": [...], "kind": "video", "lines": [...], "summary": ...}; on failure vex.factory.step.fail with the reason.

steps.name: shoot
steps.job: Role: cinematographer for this shot. Load and follow skill seedance-plates and the field notes it cites; use the perform step's files when present (motion-control). Make 2 takes of the shot under <dir>/plates/<id>/ from its start frame and shot brief, draft first, logging spend to <dir>/ledger.jsonl. Record the step with vex.factory.step.complete: {"files": [absolute paths you wrote], "kind": "video", "summary": "<2 lines>"}. If the unit cannot be made, vex.factory.step.fail with the reason. Never edit shared project files (brief, bible, tokens, assets.json, shots.json, edit, mix).

steps.name: retake
steps.job: Role: the same cinematographer (and actors). Read the take critic's verdicts and any director answer. If the best take passes, record it unchanged as {"files": [best take], "kind": "video", "span": [start, end]} with the usable span. If not, make at most ONE new take that fixes the named defects (same rules as the shoot step), and record the better of the two. Never more than 3 takes per shot in total. Also run canon_check.py on the best take (video: it checks 3 frames) with the shot's family; a take with a NO on a blocking item does not pass.

steps.name: approve
steps.question: Director: use the critic's best take for this shot (continue), re-shoot (redo), or drop the shot (close)?
